reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

Cited text supports compliance: p0013 compensates Contractor on a time-and-materials basis 'as set forth in each Statement of Work' and p0004 engages Contractor 'on a task by task basis,' so fees are payable only for services actually ordered — matching the preferred position of no minimum commitment.

No take-or-pay, minimum volume, shortfall or usage-cap language appears in the supplied paragraphs or definitions, and p0033 limits termination payment to fees 'incurred or earned ... through the effective date,' i.e., a true-up rather than a penalty.

Rationale appropriately flags residual risk in unseen Statements of Work while noting the Agreement controls over conflicting SOW terms; the incidental section-label references (e.g., calling p0033 'Section 6(b)' and citing a convenience-termination limit not in the excerpt) are immaterial to the compliance conclusion.
